login.subtitle: Ask about sales, stock and branch performance in plain language — and get answers you can trace back to your own data.
login.heroSubtitle: Compare outlets, spot what moved, and see the numbers behind each answer.
login.registerSubtitle: Register your business and connect your first branch.
login.footer: Multi-branch retail & F&B · Owner, manager and staff roles

home.emptySubtitle: Add your first branch to start tracking sales, stock and staff per location.
home.queryBody: The query engine turns plain-language questions into answers computed from your own sales data, with the numbers behind every answer. It switches on once an AI provider is connected.
home.queryExample1: What were October sales versus last year?
home.queryExample2: Which branch had the lowest sales last month, and why?
home.queryExample3: Compare my Ahmedabad and Surat outlets this week.
home.dataSubtitle: Upload sales history from CSV or Excel — the ingestion pipeline is already live.

home.supplySubtitle: Cart what the branch needs and send it to the warehouse
home.deskSubtitle: Every incoming supply order, from every branch

phase.examplesLabel: What you'll be able to ask

reports.title: Reports
reports.noticeBody: Compare any set of branches against each other and against your company average, then browse the same numbers the chat answers are computed from — so figures can never drift between asking and browsing.
reports.example1: Top and bottom performing branches by any metric
reports.example3: City and region grouping for franchise networks

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.noticeBody: Scheduled checks watch your data for sustained sales decline, wastage outliers and unusual cash-versus-digital mix, then raise an alert with the one or two metrics most likely behind it.
alerts.example1: A branch whose sales have slipped for several days running
alerts.example2: Wastage rates drifting above the company norm

inviteMember.title: Invite a member
inviteMember.subtitle: If they already have a BizIQ account they'll be added right away. If not, they'll join automatically the moment they sign up with this email.
inviteMember.emailHint: works even before they've signed up
inviteMember.roleHint_ADMIN: Full access to every branch and setting, same as an owner except billing.
inviteMember.roleHint_MANAGER: Full access to every branch and setting, the same as an admin.
inviteMember.roleHint_STAFF: Limited, operational access to the branches you grant below.
inviteMember.roleHint_WAREHOUSE: Sees every branch’s supply orders, fulfils and dispatches them. No access to staff records.
inviteMember.roleHint_CASHIER: Runs the counter, orders raw material, logs expenses and manages their own branch’s staff, in the branches you grant below.
inviteMember.roleHint_DELIVERY_AGENT: Carries supply orders and marks them delivered, in the branches you grant below.
